tagline: Prove Every SEO Change on Live HTML & Rank in AI Search Engines
valueProposition: Other SEO apps show vanity scores while your changes fail silently on the storefront. ProofSEO verifies every meta tag, schema, and ALT text directly against your live rendered HTML. Plus, unlock visibility for AI Shopping engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews with zero storefront code bloat.
features: Live-Page Proof Engine: Verifies every single title, description, and schema change on your live storefront HTML
Zero-Bloat JSON-LD Rich Snippets: Product, Breadcrumb, Merchant Return Policy & Shipping schema with 0kb runtime JS
AI Shopping & Search Visibility: Product completeness auditing for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews
AI Citation Engine: Weekly audits tracking whether ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity recommend your store for buying queries
Search Console Intent Engine: Real measured keyword positions, CTR opportunity finder, and keyword cannibalisation alerts
IndexNow Instant Pings: Instantly notifies Bing, Yandex, and Seznam whenever products or collections are updated
Smart 301 Redirects: Automatic handle-change redirect creation and intelligent 404 target matching
howItWorks:
1. Install ProofSEO on your store in 1 click.
2. Run a full store crawl to uncover real missing metadata, schema conflicts, and AI completeness gaps.
3. Apply optimizations safely with Manual-Value Protection that never overwrites human-written copy.
4. The Proof Engine automatically fetches your live storefront HTML to prove that every change actually landed.
